episodes.synopsis: Nagatoro is still torturing Senpai, laughing at his choice of manga and at how he talks to girls, and trying to get a reaction out of him by having him put her stockings on her.
episodes.title: It's You and Me, Senpai~

episodes.synopsis: The club president gives Senpai tickets to the zoo, insisting that he takes Nagatoro with him to practice life drawing together.
episodes.title: You're Inviting Me, Senpai?!

episodes.synopsis: Nagatoro forgets her phone in the club room. Senpai tries to bring it back to her but gets himself into a situation.
episodes.title: Senpai... Were You... Listening to What I Said...?

episodes.synopsis: Senpai visits Nagatoro’s home to deliver handouts from school. Her sister lets him in and decides to mess with both him and Nagatoro.
episodes.title: Why Don't You Come Inside, Senpai-kun?

episodes.synopsis: Senpai gets sick, so Nagatoro comes over to check on him. His family happens not to be home.
episodes.title: So This Is Your Room, Huh, Senpai?

episodes.synopsis: Senpai has a Christmas gift for Nagatoro, but The Friends get in the way of him handing it to her.
episodes.title: How Are Your Fortunes This Year, Senpai?

episodes.synopsis: Senpai, Nagatoro and their classmates go skiing. Nagatoro is a good skier, but Senpai doesn't fail to disappoint.
episodes.title: I Figured That's How You'd Ski, Senpai

episodes.synopsis: Senpai sketches Nagatoro in an athletic stance that seems very natural to her. Wait, is Nagatoro into judo...?
episodes.title: Why Don't You Try Bulking Up a Little, Paisen?

episodes.synopsis: The school judo tournament is coming up. Senpai and Nagatoro are both reluctant to participate.
episodes.title: That Is, If You Win at Least Once, Senpai

episodes.synopsis: It's the start of a new school year. Nagatoro is planning to join the judo club and the art club gets a new member.
episodes.title: Hachioji-senpai Taught Me a Lot

episodes.synopsis: Sunomiya encourages Senpai to ask Nagatoro out on a date. On a late walk home Senpai tries to ascertain if Nagatoro has anywhere she'd like to go on her next school break.
episodes.title: Don't You Miss Me, Senpai?

episodes.synopsis: Pursued by Gamo and Yoshi who aim to preserve Senpai's virginity and Sunomiya and the President who aim to protect and fight for Senpai's love, Nagatoro and Senpai set off on their date to the aquarium.
episodes.title: Wanna Do Something to Make It Not a Dry Run?
